daily.title: Senior Citizen Tax Rates For Tax Year 2026-27: With Example on Different Income Levels
daily.summary: Senior citizens in India can pay tax under two systems: the New Regime and the Old Regime.For Tax Year 2026–27, the New Regime has the same slabs for ever This guide compares the two in simple steps, so you can pick the one that saves you more tax. Tax Year 2026–27 is the same period as FY 2026–27 (AY 2027–28) under the older terminology. Tax is progressive, so each rate applies only to the income inside its band. A 4% Health and Education Cess is added on top, and a surcharge applies at higher incomes.

breaking.title: Credit Card Spending Jumps 20% In October To Rs 2.45 Lakh Cr: RBI
breaking.summary: Transaction volumes grow faster, increasing 31.8 per cent over the same period Credit card transactions in India gathered pace in October, with total spending climbing to Rs 2.45 lakh crore, as festive-season purchases and increased payment activity drove a sharp month-on-month rise, according to the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) latest payment data. The value of credit card transactions increased 20.1 per cent from Rs 2.04 lakh crore in September. On a year-on-year basis, spending rose 14.4 per cent from Rs 2.14 lakh crore recorded in October 2025. Transaction volumes grew faster, increasing 31.8 per cent over the same period.
